about: Proposed region definitions for detailed maps of France: 18 administrative regions, the five overseas regions included, one region each. See docs/REGIONS-FR.md.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:FR codes: FR-ARA, FR-BFC, FR-BRE, FR-CVL, FR-GES, FR-HDF, FR-IDF, FR-NAQ, FR-NOR, FR-OCC, FR-PAC, FR-PDL, FR-20R (Corsica), FR-971, FR-972, FR-973, FR-974, FR-976 (overseas).
codes.why: A bare FR is not in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py) but is the whole country. No part after the hyphen is a US code: all are three characters, US codes two letters. The overseas ISO 3166-1 codes GP, MQ, GF, RE, YT are not US codes either.
codes.risk: Read in the code, not run: a map id only has to match NAME in engine/setup/manifest.py (^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,120}$), so FR-IDF, FR-20R and FR-971 pass. An address index id must be exactly two capital letters ([A-Z]{2} in validate()), and carry_over() in engine/setup/install.py keeps only index files named that way, so no hyphenated code can have an address index until those two rules are widened.
codes.verified: Checked against ISO's Online Browsing Platform, entry for FR, opened in a browser on 2026-11-17 (the site refuses automated access): all 18 codes are in its list. Debian iso-codes data and the English Wikipedia page ISO 3166-2:FR (both opened) agree. ISO's change history: FR-COR became FR-20R on 2020-11-24; FR-GP, FR-MQ, FR-GF, FR-RE, FR-YT were deleted on 2021-11-25. The older forms are not used.

terrain.dataset: BD ALTI 25 m (ASCII grid per department)
terrain.notes: Bare ground, derived from RGE ALTI. About 2.6 GB for 83 of 104 department files (21 rate-limited); about 3 GB in all (estimate). Lambert-93 or local UTM: needs reprojection to one-degree geographic tiles. Overseas editions 2013 to 2015 for Mayotte, Guadeloupe, Martinique.
Updates stopped in 2024. Radar in the Alps, Pyrenees, Cévennes and Corsica. 5 m about 38.9 GB, 1 m about 769 GB (derived from feed sizes).

terrain.notes: Record: to cover metropolitan France and the overseas regions except Guyane by 2026. A 5 m version announced.

crops.verified: feed opened; licence and classes on IGN not checked

buildings.verified: feed and file footers opened; counts measured on the WFS
buildings.notes: 51,484,368 buildings on the WFS, 96.7 % with hauteur. Whole-France GeoParquet batiment file 7.39 GB; GPKG per region and department. hauteur runs from the lowest ground point to the top of the eaves (roof edge, or top of the wall under a flat roof), not the ridge (BD TOPO 3.5 content description, July 2026, opened).
No heights. Licence from the data.gouv.fr record of the cadastral plan; the cadastre site states none.
OSM building=yes: 46,605,146 objects. Microsoft footprints not proposed (CDLA Permissive 2.0 per its README, ODbL per Overture).

postal_code.format: Five digits; leading zeros are common (01000 Bourg-en-Bresse). First two digits usually the department; Corsica keeps 20, overseas 971 to 976; some communes use a neighbouring department's code.

addressing.order: Number, street type and name, then postcode and town ("10 rue de Rivoli, 75001 Paris").
addressing.notes: normalize() and norm() keep only a-z and 0-9 ("Église" becomes "glise"); is_address_query() accepts "75001 Paris" as an address; _parts() reads a postcode only as the last word; a last word equal to a US code is taken as a state; tools/build_addresses.py keeps only country = 'US', and for France would store an empty city and the first two letters of the commune as the state. Tried in this repository on 2026-11-17.
